letter_no.description: The letter number as printed near the top left, e.g. '2082/83'.

ref_no.description: The reference number as printed below Letter No. at upper left.

office_name.description: Office full name, usually topmost, e.g. 'Nagarjun Municipality 10 No. Ward Office'.

municipality.description: Municipality name, as part of header (e.g. Nagarjun Municipality).

province.description: Province name in header (e.g. Bagmati Province).

date.description: Issued date in YYYY-MM-DD or B.S. as on the right (e.g. 2025-10-19).

subject.description: Subject printed at start of main body, e.g. 'RELATIONSHIP VERIFICATION' or translated.

main_text.description: The main certification statement confirming family relationship, up to but not including the member table/photos. Preserve all named individuals verbatim.

family_members.description: List of family members with relationship, name, and role shown with photograph (left to right in the row below). Push all visible: Applicant, Father, Mother, Sister.

name.description: Family member's full name as printed below photo.

relation.description: Relationship to applicant, as label below name (e.g. Applicant, Father, Mother, Sister).

ward_chairperson_name.description: Name of certifying official (Ward Chairperson) with signature at lower right (e.g. Sundar Bahadur K.C).

ward_chairperson_title.description: Title of certifying officer, typically 'Ward Chairperson'.
